HelpMotionPaused: Animation paused by your motion preferences.
HelpDemo: Illustration only. Your current settings stay in place.
HelpGuideBody:
Choose a preset, then open an image tile to adjust an effect. Each editor keeps its main controls at the top and extra options under More.

Add your own local images, videos and recordings in Library. Press START to run your selected effects. The panic key stops them together while panic is enabled. Close the main window to exit.

Use the topics here or the ? beside an editor title for a demonstration and instructions. Nothing in the guide starts a session.
HelpFlashBody:
Flash Images places selected Library images around the screen. Adjust the rate, dismissal mode and size first. More contains opacity, fades and the maximum number shown together.

Click dismissal waits for a click. Hydra can bring back two images after a dismissal. Use a low rate and maximum while finding a comfortable combination.
HelpVideoBody:
Mandatory Videos selects local videos from Library. Choose the rate, strict mode and floating presentation. More contains the attention check, concurrent video limit, starting with the session and maximum play time in minutes.

Videos always play at normal speed. Floating videos can continue while you use other apps. An attention question pauses playback while you answer. Strict mode prevents closing an individual video; the shared panic gate still follows your panic setting.
HelpSubBody:
Subliminals briefly shows the approved words. Adjust the rate and opacity, then enable whispers if wanted. More contains display duration in frames and color.

Whispers use the supplied recordings and your Audio volume. Lower the rate or use Gentle visuals to soften the presentation.
HelpSpiralBody:
Spiral adds a transparent animated layer while leaving the desktop usable. Adjust its opacity and choose a style.

Open Loom to create a spiral, change its layers and colors, and save it in the rack. Select a saved spiral to use it in the session. Reduced motion holds a still frame.
HelpPinkBody:
Pink Filter places a transparent color wash over the desktop. Its opacity controls how strong the wash appears.

Under More, choose whether it follows the session. The wash leaves pointer input available to the windows beneath it.
HelpBubbleBody:
Bubble Pop sends bubbles upward. Adjust their rate and choose whether clicks pop them. Sound adds a short non-speech pop.

Popping a bubble contributes to local Progress. Gentle visuals softens the movement, and Reduced motion keeps the presentation still.
HelpLockBody:
Lock Card opens a phrase card at the selected interval. Type the displayed phrase for the required number of repetitions. A typing mistake keeps that repetition open.

Strict mode prevents closing an individual card. The shared panic gate follows your panic setting, and closing the main window exits the application.
HelpBounceBody:
Bouncing Text moves approved words around the available view. Adjust its speed, size and opacity.

Corner hits contribute to local Progress. Gentle visuals slows movement; Reduced motion holds the text still.
HelpWipeBody:
Mind Wipe plays an approved recording at the chosen interval and volume. Enable Loop to repeat after a recording finishes successfully.

Pauses and stopped or failed recordings do not count as completed playback. All effects and recordings end together when a permitted stop occurs.
HelpDrainBody:
Brain Drain adds a translucent visual layer at the selected intensity. Increase it gradually to find the presentation you want.

High refresh is an extra option. Performance and motion preferences limit work and movement on this display.
HelpAudioBody:
Audio controls the master and video volumes. Ducking lowers Classic's other recordings while a video plays, then restores them.

Classic uses your local audio output. It does not change the volume of other applications. Tutorial animations are silent.
HelpWallBody:
Wallpaper creates a static or moving wallpaper from your selected local images. Choose the mode and adjust its options before starting.

Wallpaper is available on Windows. Classic restores the previous wallpaper when the session ends.
HelpLibraryBody:
Add local image, video and recording folders, then select the files available to each effect. Images, videos and audio have separate groups.

Selections are stored locally and apply to the next session. Removing an item from Library leaves the original file on disk. Missing files are skipped.
HelpCompanionBody:
Enable the companion to show its avatar. Recorded barks can play at the chosen interval. The approved phrases are Breathe, Relax, Focus, Listen and Deeper.

Trigger phrases can add an effect response. Keyword triggers are optional and listen for the matching typed suffix only while enabled. A permitted stop disables keyword listening. No text history is saved.
HelpToysBody:
Toys connects supported local devices through a localhost provider. Connect the provider and choose intensity and patterns before enabling output.

Audio sync follows decoded sound energy and becomes still during silence, pauses or unavailable analysis. Disconnecting or a permitted stop sends zero output. Device support depends on your local provider.
HelpPresetsBody:
A preset recalls a set of effect choices. Choose a built-in card as a starting point, then adjust individual tiles.

Save your current choices as a named local preset. Recalling a preset restores those choices. You can remove your own presets without changing the built-in set.
HelpProgressBody:
Progress records activity locally: session time, completed playback and interactions such as bubble pops and corner hits.

Badge cards show their condition and completion. Interrupted or failed playback does not count as a completed clip. Progress is kept on this computer without an account.
HelpSettingsBody:
Settings contains language, startup behavior, monitor choices, the panic key and visual preferences. Gentle visuals softens effects. Reduced motion holds moving effects still. Performance reduces rendering work.

Learn the panic key before a session. Turning panic off changes every manual stop gesture through the same gate. Closing the main window always exits and releases local playback.
